subject: Object opener: six kids' water bottles out on the counter, the sports bag open beside them with no bottle inside. No people.
status: keyframe v01 approved/locked; one Fast silent motion test approved ($0.40 cap)
use: 0.00–1.75 s (hook A/C/D) or 0.00–2.25 s (hook B), cut from a 4 s generation; every hook uses the same footage

input.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, shot like a premium smartphone consumer ad: natural, true to life, unglamorous. Late afternoon in an ordinary, comfortable Midwestern family home, on the kitchen counter by the back door. Exactly six reusable kids' water bottles stand in a loose, slightly messy cluster on the counter: mismatched colours (teal, coral, navy, lime, purple, white), different shapes and sizes, a couple with scuffs and old sticker residue, one lying on its side. Right beside them, a plain navy youth soccer duffel bag sits unzipped and open toward the camera; inside you can clearly see small cleats and a pair of shin guards, and the bottle pocket is visibly empty. The composition reads instantly: lots of bottles out here, none in the bag. Camera at counter height, slightly above, roughly 26mm smartphone-equivalent lens, the bottles and the open bag sharp in the middle of the frame, background kitchen softly readable. Warm late-afternoon window light from the left, around 4500K, soft realistic shadows. No people, no hands. Absolutely no text, no logos, no brand names, no labels, no stickers with writing, no team crest or numbers anywhere.

Vertical 9:16, realistic smartphone-style footage of an ordinary family moment, real-time speed, natural light. Same kitchen counter as the photo: the six water bottles stay exactly where they are, same count, same colours, all clearly visible beside the open navy soccer bag. A single adult hand (forearm only, no face, no body in frame) comes in from the right edge, lifts the open bag's flap a little and briefly rummages, checking inside, making it obvious that there is no water bottle in the bag, only the cleats and shin guards, then the hand pauses. Very subtle natural handheld camera sway only. Calm, everyday, not dramatic.
input.negative_prompt: text, subtitles, captions, logos, brand names, labels, watermark, numbers, phone screen, user interface, face, head, second person, extra hands, deformed fingers, bottles moving by themselves, bottles appearing or disappearing, bottle count changing, bottle put into the bag, objects morphing, fast camera move, zoom, cut, slow motion, dramatic lighting

video.direction_note: 2026-11-21 user direction: open bag, slight natural rummage/check, clearly no bottle inside, six bottles stay visible, subtle camera only, no text/logos/new faces. Hand = forearm only.

accept_if: exactly six bottles, countable at a glance on a phone
the bag is clearly open and clearly has no bottle in it
no readable text, logo, brand, label or number anywhere
reads in under ~1.5 s, with clean negative space for the hook line in the top third
